corrected_start_analysis.conclusion: Executable routine ends with RTS at PRG 259407. The immediately following bytes at 259408 and 259418 are two valid 10-byte records. The previous 259428 start omitted them. Correct contiguous span is 64 records from 259408 through 260047.

corrections: Previous 62-record start at 259428 was too late by 20 bytes. Correct structural span is 64 records starting at 259408.

deep_batch_4.mapper71_mapping_note: For the 256 KiB PRG image, fixed-bank CPU addresses $C000-$FFFF correspond to the final 16 KiB PRG bank (file PRG offsets 245760..262143). Therefore table PRG offset 259408 maps to CPU $F550; previous $F564 was record index 2, not the table start.
deep_batch_4.important_correction: Earlier analysis treated $F564 as the table base. After restoring the two leading records, the structural base is $F550. $F564 is 20 bytes into the table.

exhaustive_operand_scan.warning: Most hits are in switchable banks/data and cannot be called executed references without bank/control-flow proof.

deep_batch_4.next_required_proof: Disassemble the final fixed bank from known vectors/control-flow roots, then retain only reachable instructions referencing $F550-$F7CF.

control_flow_batch.conclusion: Recursive control-flow trace from NMI/RESET/IRQ in the fixed bank reaches the routine ending at F54F and does not fall through into F550 table data. No reachable direct absolute instruction in this conservative trace references F550-F7CF. Table access is therefore likely indirect/indexed through RAM/pointer state or from switchable-bank code; semantics remain unassigned.
control_flow_batch.caveat: Trace follows official 6502 lengths, direct JSR/JMP and relative branches in the fixed bank; indirect JMP targets and mapper-selected switchable-bank execution require separate state-aware analysis.

fixed_bank_search.note: The two reachable-looking A9 #$50 sites store $50 into $A3 but are followed by unrelated constants ($1A/$12 into $93), so they are not evidence of constructing pointer $F550.

indirect_access_batch.inference: No literal $F550 pointer construction was found in the fixed bank. Combined with zero reachable direct absolute references, access is not a simple fixed-bank absolute/literal-base load. Next target is switchable-bank code and RAM pointer provenance.
indirect_access_batch.evidence_level: byte-search plus fixed-bank context; no field semantics assigned

mapper_write_batch.finding: The fixed bank contains a systematic family of immediate-value stores into C00A..C017-like addresses. This is stronger evidence of a bank/trampoline mechanism than treating arbitrary >=8000 stores as mapper writes. Bank value 13 is explicitly present in the family (A9 0D / STA C017 at about EF6C).
mapper_write_batch.caution: The exact hardware/software role of these C00x addresses is not yet assigned; they may be RAM-backed bank-call state/trampoline data rather than direct mapper registers.
mapper_write_batch.bank13_status: Selection/value 13 is now evidenced in reachable fixed-bank neighborhood, but reachability from that mechanism to bank13 candidate AA66 still needs instruction-level tracing.

bank13_trace_from_b265.key_finding: The proven bank-13 entry immediately performs indexed-indirect data reads through zero-page pointer $12/$13. This supplies a concrete mechanism by which fixed-bank data can be consumed without any literal F550 operand in the bank-13 code.
bank13_trace_from_b265.implication: The next decisive target is provenance of zero-page $12/$13 at the EF6C -> B265 call site. If it resolves to F550 (or an offset within F550-F7CF), table access and record semantics can be traced from real code.
